title: A Writer binds repeat.previous to the preceding element of the tree
description: Each Item is written with the Total of the element before it, as written (0 for the first), and its Pad is base + 1 bytes: 1, 2 and 4 bytes, so the output is 01 AA 02 BB CC 03 DD EE FF 11. A Writer that bound another element, or Null, would size Pad differently and refuse the tree.
